format: startup with emoji headings and bullet-character items; non-vocabulary 'Our Stack' heading
note: 'Our Stack' (after the tools emoji) is Title Case followed by a list, so it is an unknown heading that ends the required section: MATLAB and SolidWorks are unscored, not required. 'Location' is not vocabulary and fails R2.2 rule 4, so it is body text in Benefits (no skills). In Benefits, SolidWorks loses to its unscored mention (precedence) while Six Sigma appears only there (excluded; the resume's Six Sigma Yellow Belt must not be found). Resume: BMS is really negated; 'no manual post-processing', 'zero test-cell damage', 'without a dedicated acoustics lab' are not negations.
posting_text:
⚡ Ampere Motorworks | Powertrain Test Engineer

We're a 40-person team building electric drivetrains for last-mile delivery vans. Everyone here gets their hands dirty.

👋 Who you are
• You've run dyno or HIL test campaigns on an EV powertrain or e-motor
• You're comfortable with CAN bus tools and writing test scripts in Python
• You can turn messy data into clear technical reports

🛠️ Our Stack
• MATLAB/Simulink, Python, Jira
• SolidWorks for test fixtures

🌟 Nice to haves
• Regenerative braking calibration experience
• Familiarity with battery management systems and NVH testing

🍕 Benefits
• Free lunch Fridays and a Six Sigma or SolidWorks course stipend
• Commuter e-bike program

📍 Location
Fremont, CA. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
resume_text:
DANIELA ORTIZ
Test Engineer • Fremont, CA

SUMMARY
Test engineer with 4 years on EV powertrain validation. Comfortable at the dyno, in
the lab and in front of customers.

EXPERIENCE
Validation Engineer, Corvane EV (2021 to present)
• Ran 1,200 hours of e-motor dyno testing with zero test-cell damage events
• Built CAN bus logging in Python and MATLAB; no manual post-processing needed after
rollout
• Authored technical reports for regenerative braking calibration releases
• Characterized NVH on the gearbox without a dedicated acoustics lab
Test Technician, Hilltop Motors (2019 to 2021)
• No experience with battery management systems; supported pack teardown only

SKILLS
Python, MATLAB/Simulink, CANalyzer, LabVIEW, SolidWorks (basic), Six Sigma Yellow Belt
